text: In our build, the callback made by CreateInternalCallback, for each kProcessing Responses with text, appends Responses::GetTexts()[0] to a per-reply accumulated string and scans it from a cursor for channel and tool-call delimiters: text outside channels goes to the user callback as a Message built by model_data_processor.ToMessage from a copy of the released slice (SendMessage), channel text as {"role": "assistant", "channels": {name: text}} plus "reasoning_content": text for a reasoning channel such as thought (SendMessageToChannel), and a tool-call block is held until its end delimiter; on kDone, or on kMaxNumTokensReached when return_error_on_max_tokens_reached is false, SendCompleteMessage sends the unflushed text, builds the complete message from the whole accumulated text, calls complete_message_callback and then calls the user callback with an empty Message.

text: In our build (CPU sampler, because no Metal sampler is linked), a plain Gemma 4 E4B decode step on the GPU writes 53,248 bytes of embeddings into the decode inputs (the token's 2,560-float embedding and 42 x 256-float per-layer embedding, FLOAT32) and the CPU sampler reads 524,288 bytes of FP16 logits (262,144 entries) back: 577,536 bytes per step, not counting the attention mask (one byte per allocated position), input_pos and param_tensor.

text: Our engine telemetry (agello/telemetry, in our build and the release Agello ships) defines five levels in agello_telemetry.h: 0 off; 1 counters and anomalies; 2 adds span aggregates (count, total, max, log2 histogram) and DynamicTracing signposts; 3 adds per-thread span ring buffers written as a Chrome/Perfetto trace; 4 adds diagnostic modes that change timing (per-kernel GPU timing, numerical probes); the counter, span, gauge, anomaly and logit probes read the level with one relaxed atomic load before recording anything, while engine facts (SetFact) are stored at every level, 0 included.
